name: Fall Down Fast
steps: Tap the backpack to reveal the hidden items.
Drag the umbrella to the girl.
Drag the flashlight to the car driver.
Drag the wrench to the front tire.
Drag the helmet onto the girl.
Drag the banana into the exhaust pipe.
Take the magazine from the trunk.
Drag the magazine to the passenger.
Drag the magnet to the flying drone.
Watch the drone crash and complete the level.
